cleanTruthBoundary: The app receives only noisy observations and application events. Clean geometry, diary positions, intended turns, classification labels, and evaluation tolerances remain private evaluation evidence.

required: live Mapbox walking Directions response with full GeoJSON geometry
every returned step is walking and no motorized or water transport is present
route is reviewed over a Mapbox basemap before it is valid evidence
public street, sidewalk, park path, shared path, or independently documented trail provenance
clean diary is frozen before sensor noise, loss, lifecycle, or network schedules
reject: straight chord through buildings, walls, water, or inaccessible terrain
unbounded detour, unsupported transport mode, or missing walk geometry

providerBudget.note: Every live request is counted. Captured provider responses are replayed for deterministic comparisons.
